objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other document in DHC VISION.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used to define templates, validity periods, archive duration, and naming abbreviation.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted PDF version displayed on the web after a document is saved.

objs.name: user
objs.description: System participant who may create, edit, review, release, read, translate, acknowledge, or initiate requests.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access, or technical role availability.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a document, released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing flow for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed in the system.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system to users involved in workflows, change proposals, releases, validity extension, distribution, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected released document and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document with assigned user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific document list filled from distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, workflow status, validity status, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the defined templates when creating a new document object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploads or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and control properties of a document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF with system support.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translation participants in the document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment associated with a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step document release workflow after document creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes release so the document is released.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject a review or release task, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is revised or specified changes occur.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document editing of an assigned change proposal directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically create a validity extension request 30 days before document validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity for a document, delete the request, and update the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_override
evts.description: Process an override request with workflow support.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document and its attachments invalid and archive them by revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Process a reactivation request with workflow support by the request creator.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document and restore maintained metadata, authorizations, distribution list, and archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request persons and users of assigned user groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a document without a signature.

evts.name: display_document_in_dashboard
evts.description: Assign and list documents in user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports or searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_addition_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for local additions and reference the original document.

o2o.description: A document has a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
A saved document is converted to a PDF displayed on the web.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reader authorization, distribution, and access rights.
Users or persons can be assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, or distribution recipient.
Attachments can be added to each document and are controlled with the main document.
Additional information can be added to each document.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
Workflow processing assigns tasks to participants.
Workflow participants complete release tasks with an electronic signature.
The system informs involved users of workflow task status and existence by e-mail notification.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding invalidated document.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Persons or users can be assigned to the distribution list.
Acknowledgement confirms taking note of a document version.
Documents relevant to users are listed in the dashboard.
Reports evaluate documents or instructions stored in the system.
A document can be specified as visible or not in clients.
Documents can reference other documents; local addition documents reference the original document.
